title: The Penrose Correspondence over a Non-Archimedean Field
summary: Let $K$ be a non-Archimedean local field of characteristic different from $2$ and let $V$ be a four-dimensional symplectic $K$-vector space. We study the Penrose incidence correspondence $\mathbb{P}(V) \leftarrow \mathrm{Flag}(1,2;V) \rightarrow \mathrm{Gr}(2,V)$ after Berkovich analytification. The Klein quadric $\mathrm{Gr}(2,V)$ decomposes into the open orbit $\mathrm{Spin}(5)/\mathrm{Spin}(4)$ and the Lagrangian quadric, which parametrize respectively the projective lines transverse and tangent to the standard contact distribution on $\mathbb{P}(V)$.
